title: Craft Local
venue_description:
Craft Local - A Hub for Local Arts and Music

Craft Local stands as Billings' premier nonprofit arts and music venue located on Montana Avenue. Since opening in 2017 the venue has become an essential part of the city's cultural landscape providing space for local artists to exhibit their work and musicians to develop their craft and connect with audiences.

Mission and Philosophy

Craft Local operates on four core principles: Foster Educate Support and Develop. The organization is dedicated to encouraging artisans of all types while promoting local artists craftsmen and musicians. Through various classes and workshops Craft Local helps grow the cultural scene in Billings giving new meaning to Montana Avenue as a creative corridor.

Music Programming

The venue hosts an impressive array of music events throughout the week. Wednesday nights feature the Billings Singer Songwriter Association Open Mic hosted by Almeda Bradshaw and John Adams where musicians share original compositions and covers. Thursday evenings bring jazz enthusiasts together for the weekly jazz jam session. Friday and Saturday nights showcase local and touring bands across multiple genres including rock indie folk bluegrass and alternative music.

Craft Local is notably the only venue in Billings with a consistent open mic night making it an essential platform for aspiring musicians to build their fan base develop performance skills and connect with other artists. The venue has hosted everything from young musicians just starting out to experienced performers providing a supportive environment where artists can grow.

Venue Features

The space features distinctive architectural elements including exposed brick walls high ceilings and a dedicated stage area creating an intimate yet spacious atmosphere perfect for live performances. The walls serve as gallery space showcasing work from local artists that cannot be found in traditional gallery spaces around Billings.

Bar and Refreshments

Craft Local offers an impressive selection of 28 local beers on tap at very affordable prices with pints typically around $4. The bar also features wines from Yellowstone Valley Winery including Malbec and seasonal whites plus sparkling ciders seltzers and sodas ensuring options for both alcoholic and non-alcoholic preferences. Basic bar food including pizzas and snacks is available.

Community Impact

Under new management since late 2024 when a group of local musicians and business owners including Brian Zoller came together to save the venue from closure Craft Local continues its vital role in the Billings music community. The new management team is focused on eliminating cover charges before 8 PM for most shows making the venue more accessible and welcoming to casual visitors.

The venue serves as a bridge between generations of musicians fostering connections between established artists like John Roberts and emerging young talent. This intergenerational approach ensures the continuity and growth of Billings' music scene.

Special Events and Classes

Beyond regular music nights Craft Local provides various art craft and music classes to the public. The venue hosts special fundraisers private events and community gatherings reinforcing its role as a cultural cornerstone of downtown Billings. The nonprofit structure allows Craft Local to focus on community benefit rather than profit prioritizing accessibility and artistic development.

Atmosphere and Accessibility

Located on Montana Avenue the venue offers street parking and is easily accessible from downtown Billings. The long narrow space may appear empty from the street but the crowd typically gathers toward the back near the bar and stage creating an intimate welcoming environment. The venue is family-friendly and all ages are welcome at most events.

title: Levity Bar and Bistro
venue_description:
Levity Bar and Bistro - Mediterranean Elegance Meets Live Jazz

Levity Bar and Bistro has established itself as one of Billings' most romantic and sophisticated venues for live music combining Mediterranean cuisine fine wines and exceptional jazz performances. Located in the Shiloh Crossing shopping area the venue offers a unique blend of upscale dining and entertainment.

The Wednesday Jazz Jam Experience

Every Wednesday evening from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM Levity hosts what many consider the best jazz night in Billings. The weekly jazz jam features a house rhythm section led by pianist Joe Sullivan with Lloyd Marsh on drums and Robin Martinez on bass. Each week brings different guest artists from the Billings area and musicians are welcome to bring their instruments and sit in with the band.

The jazz jam has developed a dedicated following with a core group of regulars attending nearly every week. The atmosphere during jazz night is intimate and sultry making it the perfect setting for date nights or sophisticated evenings out. Patrons are encouraged to arrive by 7:00 PM as the venue fills up quickly and seating can become limited.

Culinary Offerings

Levity Bar and Bistro specializes in Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with the highest quality freshest ingredients. The menu features stone fire pizzas build-your-own salads panini bruchetta crostini and insalata. Bistro starters and cheese and meat boards pair perfectly with the extensive wine selection. The venue also offers a deli case with premium imported meats and cheeses including prosciutto salami and pancetta.

Lunch is served from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM while dinner service extends through the evening. Food specials are available on Fridays and the quality-to-price ratio consistently receives high marks from diners.

Wine and Beverage Selection

As both a wine bar and bistro Levity maintains an impressive selection of wines carefully curated by knowledgeable staff. The owners and bartenders are known for their expertise and personalized recommendations ensuring guests find wines that match their preferences. In addition to wine the venue offers craft cocktails beers and non-alcoholic beverages.

Additional Entertainment

Beyond the Wednesday jazz jam Levity regularly features live music on weekends showcasing various local and regional artists. The venue has become known for quality musical entertainment across multiple genres while maintaining its sophisticated atmosphere. The space also includes casino gaming options for those interested.

Atmosphere and Ambiance

The interior of Levity Bar and Bistro features comfortable seating arrangements visually striking decor and an inviting layout that encourages relaxation and conversation. The venue maintains an elegant yet approachable atmosphere where guests can dress up or dress casually. The staff including bartenders like Josh Jade and Tessa are consistently praised for their friendly attentive service even during busy periods.

Accessibility and Parking

Located in the corner of the Shiloh Crossing shopping area near Scheels Sporting Goods Levity offers ample parking making it easily accessible. The venue is open seven days a week with extended hours on Fridays and Saturdays until 2:00 AM.

Special Services

Levity Bar and Bistro offers catering services for events of all sizes from small office luncheons to large family weddings. The venue provides personalized attentive service and can accommodate private parties. The family-friendly establishment welcomes guests of all ages during most hours.

Community Connection

Levity has become a neighborhood favorite in multiple Billings communities including Canyon Creek Cottonwood Grove and Rimrock-Laredo. The venue's commitment to quality food wine and live music has made it a staple of Billings' dining and entertainment scene. Musicians like Joe Sullivan who also performs with Little Joe and the Cartwrights and various other local artists contribute to the vibrant musical atmosphere.
location: 1027 Shiloh Crossing Blvd Suite 8 Billings MT 59102

title: The Pub Station
venue_description:
The Pub Station - Eastern Montana's Premier Music Venue

The Pub Station stands as Eastern Montana's premier independently owned music venue housed in a historic Greyhound bus station in downtown Billings. The venue has transformed this vintage space into a dynamic concert hall that hosts everything from local garage bands to Grammy-winning artists making it an essential destination for live music lovers.

Venue Spaces

The Pub Station features two distinct performance spaces. The Ballroom offers a 1000-capacity room where fans experience high-energy shows from EDM to country to rock and pop. The more intimate Taproom provides a 400-capacity setting where concertgoers can stand just feet from their musical heroes and meet artists at the merch table after shows. Both spaces feature one of the best sound systems in the West ensuring exceptional audio quality for every performance.

Music Programming

The venue's programming is remarkably diverse hosting local bands one night touring bands in transit vans the next and established touring acts and Grammy winners throughout the year. Recent performances have included Buffalo Traffic Jam Casey Donahew Kitchen Dwellers Sebastian Bach and tribute bands like Wink-183 (Blink-182 tribute). The Pub Station welcomes all genres creating an inclusive environment for music fans of every taste.

The venue has occasionally hosted special community events like Love Your Locals Week which featured music panels open mic nights and free concerts celebrating Billings' local music scene and providing platforms for emerging artists to build fan bases and promote their music.

Taproom and Beer Selection

The Pub Station's taproom offers one of the most extensive craft and domestic beer selections in Billings with an impressive number of tap handles ensuring variety for every preference. Recent additions include expanded non-alcoholic options. Happy hour specials run from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM with tiered pricing: $2 pints from 4-5 PM and $3 pints from 5-6 PM (with regular prices at $5 thereafter excluding specialty beers).

Atmosphere and Experience

The standing-room-only crowds that regularly pack The Pub Station demonstrate the venue's popularity and the quality of its programming. The former bus station's architecture provides character and history while modern upgrades ensure comfort and excellent sightlines. The venue maintains a high-energy atmosphere whether hosting mosh pits for metal shows dance floors for country acts or singing crowds for pop performances.

Safety and Service

The Pub Station employs dedicated office and security staff focused on keeping everyone safe and ensuring each patron has a wonderful evening. The professional team manages crowds effectively even during sold-out shows while maintaining a welcoming environment.

Community Impact

As an independently owned venue The Pub Station has invested significantly in the Billings community providing consistent employment supporting local businesses and giving touring artists a quality venue to perform in Eastern Montana. The venue's survival and continued operation through challenging economic periods including the COVID-19 pandemic demonstrates its importance to the local music ecosystem.

Location and Access

Located at 2502 1st Avenue N in the larger downtown Billings area The Pub Station benefits from proximity to other dining and entertainment options. Street parking is available and the venue's central location makes it easy to combine a visit with the downtown brewery walking tour or dinner at nearby restaurants.

Venue Policies

While policies vary by show outside food is typically permitted but cans glass bottles thermoses and alcoholic beverages are not allowed. Items like camera equipment beyond phones laptops drones strollers and laser pointers are generally prohibited. The venue is all-ages for most shows though some events may have age restrictions.

title: Thirsty Street Brewing
venue_description:
Thirsty Street Brewing - Craft Beer and Live Music

Thirsty Street Brewing Company operates two locations in downtown Billings offering handcrafted beers live music and a family-friendly atmosphere. The brewery has established itself as a cornerstone of Billings' craft beer scene with unique brews exceptional quality and regular entertainment.

The Beer Garage Venue

Thirsty Street at the Garage serves as the main brewing operations facility and live music venue. This converted garage space features 14 Thirsty Street beers on tap plus wine cider seltzer and non-alcoholic options. The venue hosts live music throughout the week including local and regional artists performing classic rock soul rhythm and blues country and various other genres.

The Garage has become known for fantastic live performances with bands like Christina Temple and The Band Mojo performing classic rock and soulful R&B The Hellroaring bringing honky tonk energy and Song Dog Serenade offering acoustic sets. Cover charges for shows are typically modest ($10-$15) with doors opening at 6:30 PM or 7:00 PM and all ages welcome.

Downtown Taproom

The downtown taproom at 2123 1st Avenue N provides a more casual environment with 11+ house-made beers on tap. The location features indoor and outdoor seating a game room with darts and shuffleboard ping pong nights on Tuesdays trivia every Wednesday and various community events. The taproom regularly hosts live music on weekends showcasing local talent.

Beer Selection

Thirsty Street's craft beer lineup includes flagship styles seasonal rotations and gluten-reduced options. Notable beers include the beloved Huckleweizen (Huckleberry Hefeweizen) B.A.D.A.S.S. (a barrel-aged sour stout with vanilla beans and cocoa nibs) Coffee Blonde Ale Honey Wheat Ale mixed-culture sour ales aged in oak Foeder and various brewed cocktails including Huckleberry Hard Lemonade Cosmopolitan Moscow Mule and others. Pints are affordably priced at around $4-$5.

Food and Snacks

Both locations offer house-made soft pretzels as the signature snack. The venues partner with Michelle's Pantry food service which provides expanded menu options. Delivery and food truck options may be available and guests are welcome to bring their own food at certain locations.

Events and Entertainment

Beyond live music Thirsty Street hosts a variety of community events including ping pong nights trivia competitions pint nights benefiting local nonprofits and special holiday celebrations. The brewery has hosted Christmas concerts St. Patrick's Day celebrations with Irish food and music and various tribute band performances including Fleetwood Mac and other classic rock acts.

The venues serve as gathering places for large groups and community organizations with ample space for socializing and connecting with neighbors.

Atmosphere

Thirsty Street Brewing maintains a family-friendly and dog-friendly environment welcoming guests of all ages. The atmosphere is casual and inviting with a strong focus on community connection. The Beer Garage's unique converted space offers character with its garage aesthetic while the downtown taproom provides a more traditional brewery feel.

Hours and Accessibility

The Garage operates Monday-Thursday from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM and Friday-Saturday from 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The downtown taproom has extended hours Thursday-Saturday until 11:00 PM with shorter hours Sunday-Wednesday. Both locations are easily accessible in downtown Billings with parking available.

Community Commitment

Thirsty Street Brewing has established itself as more than just a brewery - it's a community hub where art music and craft beer intersect. The venues support local artists musicians and charitable causes while providing accessible entertainment and quality beverages to Billings residents and visitors. Owners George and Marcy are known for their warm welcoming approach and genuine connection with patrons.
